title: Exact chordal separation of spherical Fibonacci points
description:
This research note proves the exact finite separation conjecture stated in Johann S. Brauchart's OWR 40/2012 contribution, published in 2013. For every integer n at least 3, the rational unshifted unit-sphere configuration with Fn points has minimum Euclidean chord 2/sqrt(Fn), uniquely at the north pole and its first latitude point. A latitude-longitude inequality reduces the all-pair lower bound to classical Fibonacci dual-lattice arithmetic. An elementary unimodular-basis proof of the weaker arithmetic bound needed here makes the argument self-contained. The older construction, pole upper bound and Zaremba product index are credited. The theorem does not assert optimal sphere packing or apply to midpoint, irrational-angle or arbitrary-cardinality variants.
